data.title: The 3.2-Å resolution structure of human mTORC2.
data.authors: Scaiola A; Mangia F; Imseng S; Boehringer D; Berneiser K; Shimobayashi M; Stuttfeld E; Hall MN; Ban N; Maier T

evidence.label: Molecular — cells, biochemistry, structure
evidence.note: this describes the kind of study, not its quality

data.finding: The 3.2 A cryo-EM structure of human mTORC2 pinpoints Rictor's C-terminus as the source of rapamycin insensitivity.
data.abstract_excerpt: The protein kinase mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) is the central regulator of cell growth. Aberrant mTOR signaling is linked to cancer, diabetes, and neurological disorders. mTOR exerts its functions in two distinct multiprotein complexes, mTORC1 and mTORC2. Here, we report a 3.2-A resolution cryo-EM reconstruction of mTORC2.

extracted_findings.effect: 3.2-Å cryo-EM structure of human mTORC2 reveals the entangled Rictor and SIN1 folds
